meta_title: G Wells Property Services | Plumber Sunderland
meta_description: G Wells Property Services is a Sunderland plumber offering emergency repairs, boiler installations, and general plumbing. Fast response times, local expertise. Call now.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe, boiler breakdown, or blocked drain in Sunderland? We're out within the hour, any time of day or night.
services_subhead: From emergency callouts to planned maintenance, we handle every plumbing job with speed and expertise.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blockages fixed fast—any time of day. Our engineers carry spare parts on the van to get you back to normal quickly.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Repair
services.desc: New boiler install, repair, or annual service. We work with all major brands and ensure your heating runs efficiently and reliably.

services.title: Central Heating Maintenance
services.desc: Radiator repairs, pump issues, and system power-flushes to keep your heating in top condition and lower your energy bills.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Plumbing
services.desc: Sink, tap, and toilet repairs, plus full bathroom and kitchen refits. We manage pipework, water pressure, and drainage to professional standards.

services.title: Drainage & Blocked Drains
services.desc: Blocked pipes cleared fast using modern equipment. We locate and clear blockages without unnecessary disruption to your home.

services.title: Leaking Roof & Gutter Repairs
services.desc: Water ingress investigations, gutter repairs, and roof leak fixes to prevent damp and structural damage.

about_pullquote: Good plumbing shouldn't cost the earth or take forever to arrange.
about_para_1: G Wells Property Services has been keeping Sunderland homes warm and dry for over 15 years. We started because we saw too many local residents overcharged by fly-by-night operators. From a single van to a trusted name across Wearside, we've built our reputation on turning up on time, doing the job right, and charging a fair price.
about_para_2: Our engineers live locally and understand the age and quirks of Sunderland properties—Victorian terraces, post-war semis, new builds, the lot. Customers come back to us again and again because we listen, explain what's wrong without the jargon, and stand behind our work.
reviews_heading: What Sunderland Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a nightmare burst pipe in the kitchen on a Sunday afternoon. Called G Wells and someone picked up straight away. Engineer was here in 40 minutes and had it sorted by dinner time. Saved us from a flooded kitchen. Really professional and fair price too. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Our boiler packed in just before Christmas. Absolutely panicked. G Wells came out the next morning, diagnosed a faulty valve, and fitted a replacement by lunchtime. Warm house, no hassle, and they even explained what had gone wrong so we know what to look out for. Would definitely use again.
reviews.author: Helen B.

reviews.text: Been using G Wells for three years now—annual boiler service, leaking radiator, and a blocked drain. Every time they've been punctual, polite, and the work's been spot on. It's nice to find a plumber you can actually trust. Highly recommend to anyone in Sunderland.
reviews.author: David W.
